mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 5.0%, the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%) signal stagflation, which triggers a sell-off in equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both CPIAUCSL > 5.0% and UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals an impending economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500.0 thousand units signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST falls below 1500.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (2017=100) and rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 5.0% signals a supply shock, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100.0 and CPIAUCSL exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery phases, a payroll level above 155,000 thousand (PAYEMS > 155000) signals robust economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In post-recession recovery periods, SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 155000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100.0.
